name: Hespith Quillune
keeps: the names of everyone who came through
does: Signs at one door and no other. If she will not sign, that door does not move.
reason: His letter to his daughter survives, written from the cell: the confession was false and extracted, and he said so in writing while he still could.
text: Hespith quillune of the salt stair, keeps a door for the 14th tranche, doors 124 to 133. Keeps the names of everyone who came through. Reads Johannes Junius.
